title: ESPLORA: Enhanced Spatial Precision with Low-Rank Adaption in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models for High-Definition Synthesis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image generation accuracy on opposite spatial relations (e.g., top vs. bottom, left vs. right, front vs. behind) using geometric constraints on bounding boxes to calculate soft and strict accuracy, revealing model preferences for specific spatial directions.

Qualitatively analyzing model outputs to observe how specific positional phrases containing stylistic keywords (e.g., 'a painting on the right of') are misinterpreted as global stylistic modifiers ('a painting of') rather than object placement instructions.
